description: Overhead SNES-era 16-bit ocean cavern screen with flat navy water, clustered pixel ripples, dark outlined blue reef tiles and cyan/violet coral accents; actors and fish remain runtime sprites.
style: Top-down 2D pixel art; chunky square clusters, limited navy/cobalt/teal palette and flat 2-3-tone shading.
normalization: Full-frame Canvas drawImage with imageSmoothingEnabled=false; no crop, letterbox or layout transformation.
visualGeometryReview: Confirmed full water footprint at west (26,350) and north (550,26); edge channel continues visibly to image boundary. Other edge directions closed by reef. Central basin has no obstacles.
